definition_of_done: >
  1. packages/kernel exists as a TypeScript package whose runtime code imports nothing from Node or the DOM; the workspace typecheck and test commands pass from the repository root.
  2. Every planned test of the requirements of this commitment listed in dossier-recette/10_PROVENANCE_KERNEL.md (TST-KER-001a to TST-KER-014a, except those of KER-008, KER-009 and KER-012) exists under its name, runs on an in-memory storage adapter, and passes; the report names each test with its file and title.
  3. The property tests draw their inputs at random and never use the kernel as their own oracle: a brute-force reference computes the invalidated set, an independent walk computes the counts.
  4. REPORT.md opens with the result against this definition, names each requirement with the tests that prove it, and states what the coordinator can set to IMPLEMENTED.
